SELECT p.id ,p.pool_name ,p.pool_type ,p.market_codes ,p.variety_codes ,p.description ,p.max_capacity ,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.fund_code) FROM ip_pool_status_fund ps WHERE ps.target_pool_id = p.id AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0) AS current_count FROM ip_investment_pool p
AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND JSON_CONTAINS(p.variety_codes, '"fund"') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 )
AND p.id IN
#{poolId}
ORDER BY p.outer_sort ASC ,p.inner_sort ASC ,p.id ASC

SELECT fi.fund_code ,fi.fund_name ,fi.fund_short_name ,fi.security_type ,dst.security_type_name ,fi.security_status ,fi.market_code ,fi.currency_code ,fi.latest_nav ,fi.establishment_date ,fi.fund_manager_names ,fi.fund_administrator ,fi.fund_custodian ,fi.accumulated_nav ,fi.investment_style ,fi.trade_price ,fi.issue_scale ,fi.latest_scale ,fi.data_date ,fi.updt_time FROM rrs_fundinfo fi INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'fund' AND dst.is_deleted = 0
AND fi.is_deleted = 0 AND fi.security_status != 'D'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status_fund ps WHERE ps.fund_code = fi.fund_code AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status_fund ps WHERE ps.fund_code = fi.fund_code AND ps.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ps.audit_status = '20' AND ps.is_deleted = 0 )
AND fi.fund_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundCode}, '%')
AND fi.fund_short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundShortName}, '%')
AND fi.security_type = #{securityType}
AND fi.fund_administrator LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundAdministrator}, '%')
ORDER BY fi.fund_code ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND JSON_CONTAINS(p.variety_codes, '"fund"') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 )
